7.
(1) A member of the Commission may at any time
resign from his office by a letter addressed to the President in
that  behalf  and  such  resignation  shall  take  effect  upon  it
being accepted by the President in writing.
(2)  The  President  shall  on  the  recommendation  of  the
Constitutional  Council  appoint  a  new  member  in  place  of
the member who resigned, within two weeks of the resignation
of such member.
